title: Gate C: research records decided from verified results, and a bounded, resumable controller
note: Every mutation here would let a research record say more than its evidence: a verdict asserted rather than computed, an observation of an unadmitted result, a conclusion on an undecided hypothesis, a quantity read at the wrong place or in the wrong unit, a resumed controller asking its question again, or a kind with no tool contract executed; or (D-2026-178, D-2026-179) an answer that is no proposal raised, the agent's words recorded as the ledger's reason, or an objective's question answered at another point, by another model or by another prediction.

mutations.name: RS1_anyone_registers_an_objective
mutations.rationale: an agent could register a question in its owner's name, with limits the owner never set

mutations.name: RS2_a_withdrawn_hypothesis_can_be_built_on
mutations.rationale: a retraction would be undone by citing what it retracted

mutations.rationale: one agent's proposal, or a proposal of another kind, would stand as another agent's hypothesis

mutations.name: RS4_an_agent_records_its_own_hypothesis
mutations.rationale: the agent proposing and the controller recording would be the same party

mutations.rationale: a rejected or unreviewed result would become an observation a verdict can rest on

mutations.name: RS8_a_verdict_may_be_asserted
mutations.rationale: a hypothesis could be declared supported whatever the verified results say

mutations.name: RS10_a_conclusion_on_an_undecided_hypothesis
mutations.rationale: an objective could be concluded on a hypothesis nothing has decided

mutations.name: RS11_staleness_without_cause
mutations.rationale: any record could be declared stale, silently retiring evidence that still stands

mutations.name: RS12_a_conclusion_survives_an_undecided_hypothesis
mutations.rationale: a conclusion would stand after the evidence for its hypothesis began to disagree

mutations.name: RS13_a_verdict_flips_in_one_move
mutations.rationale: the latest observation would overturn a verdict without the disagreement ever being recorded

mutations.name: RS14_steps_past_the_limit
mutations.rationale: an objective's step ceiling would bound nothing

mutations.name: RS15_resolution_ignored
mutations.find:
lo = got["value"] - got["resolution"]
        hi = got["value"] + got["resolution"]
mutations.rationale: a value within its own numerical error of the threshold would decide the hypothesis

mutations.name: RS16_units_are_ignored
mutations.rationale: a value in another unit would be compared as if it were in the predicted one

mutations.name: RS17_disagreement_is_resolved_arbitrarily
mutations.rationale: disagreeing verified results would decide a hypothesis by whichever came out of a set first

mutations.name: RS18_any_output_of_the_model_answers
mutations.rationale: a temperature at one place would decide a prediction about another: same unit, different quantity

mutations.name: RL1_resume_asks_a_new_question
mutations.rationale: a restarted controller would build a new context that already contains its own step's effects, and ask the model again

mutations.name: RL2_the_step_ceiling_is_ignored
mutations.rationale: the controller would keep asking past the objective's ceiling until the ledger refused it

mutations.name: RL3_unadmitted_results_are_observed
mutations.rationale: a rejected result would be offered to the ledger as an observation
